name: Light Action GS rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 284 g for the RD-L525-GS assembly. The catalogue capacity reference uses FE-SF21/SF22/PR20 fork ends. SI-P-4 additionally requires the B-tension screw fully tightened and notes that fork/frame dimensions affect capacity.
